image.name: ungoogled-chromium
image.description: [Ungoogled Chromium](https://github.com/ungoogled-software/ungoogled-chromium) is Google Chromium, sans dependency on Google web services.

changelog.desc: Make Wayland default disable with PIXELFLUX_WAYLAND=false.
Rebase to Selkies, HTTPS IS NOW REQUIRED.
Update chromium launch options to improve performance.

env_vars.name: CHROME_CLI
env_vars.desc: Specify one or multiple Chromium CLI flags, this string will be passed to the application in full.

volumes.desc: Users home directory in the container, stores local files and settings

ports.desc: HTTP Ungoogled Chromium desktop gui, must be proxied.

custom.name: shm-size
custom.desc: This is needed for any modern website to function like youtube.

image.title: Ungoogled-chromium
image.setup_instructions:
The application can be accessed at:

* https://yourhost:3001/

snippets.docker_compose:
---
services:
  ungoogled-chromium:
    image: ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/ungoogled-chromium:latest
    container_name: ungoogled-chromium
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=Etc/UTC
      - CHROME_CLI=https://www.linuxserver.io/ #optional
    volumes:
      - /path/to/config:/config
    ports:
      - 3000:3000
      - 3001:3001
    shm_size: "1gb"
    restart: unless-stopped
snippets.docker_run:
docker run -d \
  --name=ungoogled-chromium \
  -e PUID=1000 \
  -e PGID=1000 \
  -e TZ=Etc/UTC \
  -e CHROME_CLI=https://www.linuxserver.io/ `#optional` \
  -p 3000:3000 \
  -p 3001:3001 \
  -v /path/to/config:/config \
  --shm-size="1gb" \
  --restart unless-stopped \
  ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/ungoogled-chromium:latest
